description: Provisional task-fit profiles based on official Claude model documentation, reviewed 2026-09-21. Native aliases follow account/provider configuration; documented existence is not proof of account access. Cost and latency ranks are relative, not prices or benchmarks.

candidates.description: Fastest Claude family for quick classification, extraction, literal edits and brief responses when latency is critical. Supports tools, but not configurable reasoning effort. Not the default for complex multi-module coding or deep reasoning.
Fast balanced intelligence for everyday agentic implementation, ordinary bugs, tests and bounded research. Good when responsiveness matters but the work exceeds literal extraction.

Complex agentic coding and enterprise work: coordinated changes across modules, integration constraints, substantial implementation and regression analysis. Prefer for demanding engineering without a demonstrated need for the most expensive frontier reasoning.

Demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, difficult novel architecture and deep cross-system diagnosis. Prefer when high-effort Opus attempts or evaluations have fallen short, or the task explicitly prioritizes maximum reasoning quality over speed and cost.
